evidence: Pulse time ranges of (N- iPr-AMD)3Ce and O3 were 2–10 s and 0.2–1.4 s, respectively. Purge times of (N-iPr-AMD)3Ce and O3 were investigated in the range of 5–30 s. High-purity N 2 (99.999%) was used as the carrier and purge gas with a gas ﬂow of 20 sccm. The reactor base pressure during N 2 purging was approximately 0.3 Torr.
